segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמַּפְקִיד פֵּירוֹת אֵצֶל חֲבֵירוֹ, אֲפִילּוּ הֵן אֲבוּדִין – לֹא יִגַּע בָּהֶן. רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: מוֹכְרָן בִּפְנֵי בֵּית דִּין, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא כְּמֵשִׁיב אֲבֵידָה לַבְּעָלִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who deposits produce with another, even if it is lost» due to spoilage or vermin, the bailee «may not touch it,» as it is not his. «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: He sells it before» the «court, as» by doing so «he is like» one «returning a lost item to the owner,» since through its sale he prevents the owner from losing the value of his produce.

moves.summary: bailee may not touch deteriorating produce
he sells it in court, as returning a lost item
moves.about: whether a bailee may sell deposited produce that is being lost

edges.about: whether a bailee may sell deposited produce that is being lost

positions.claim: even if the produce is being lost, the bailee may not touch it
he sells it before the court
positions.basis: it is like returning a lost item to its owner
